# Connect UnifAPI to Perplexity

> Web connector — no terminal · read-only public-data MCP over OAuth — **eyes, not hands**.

Connect Perplexity to the UnifAPI public-data MCP server and run marketing research — SEO, AI-visibility (GEO), social, local, and competitive intelligence — from live public data without leaving Perplexity. A web connector — a couple of clicks, no terminal. One OAuth sign-in, no API key to paste; everything is read-only.

## Steps

### 1. Open the connector settings

On Pro, Max, or Enterprise: open Connectors → Add Connector → Custom Connector.

[Open Perplexity connectors](https://www.perplexity.ai/computer/connectors)

### 2. Add UnifAPI

Add a custom connector named "UnifAPI" with this URL:

```text
https://mcp.unifapi.com
```

Choose OAuth, then connect.

### 3. Try it with Perplexity

```text
Use UnifAPI to pull the current top Hacker News story and summarize it.
```

[Open Perplexity with task](https://www.perplexity.ai/search?q=Use%20UnifAPI%20to%20pull%20the%20current%20top%20Hacker%20News%20story%20and%20summarize%20it.)
